newsitem.title: USA: Noel to ask holders to ok liquidation plan.
newsitem.headline: Noel to ask holders to ok liquidation plan.

text.p: Noel Group Inc said Thursday it would ask shareholders to approve a liquidation and dissolution plan at a meeting in December.
Complete distribution of company net assets may take up to three years, Noel said.
The company said that upon approval of the plan, Noel, which conducts its operations through small and medium-size operating companies, will begin liquidation of its assets "as soon as practicable."

It said that following the shareholder meeting -- whose date will be set after a Securities and Exchange Commission approval of the preliminary proxy -- complete liquidation could take up to three years.
